newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: At least one Shi'ite killed in Kabul - UN sources.
newsitem.headline: At least one Shi'ite killed in Kabul - UN sources.

text.p: At least one Shi'ite Moslem was killed in a southeastern district of Kabul, United Nations sources said on Saturday, adding that they were unable to confirm their earlier figure of 12 reported dead.
The sources said three people had been reported injured when the Islamic Taleban militia dispersed a crowd that had gathered, apparently to protest against Friday's killing.
They said a U.N. official in Kabul had earlier reported that 12 ethnic Hazara Shi'ites had been murdered and mutilated and that two people had been killed during the demonstration.
It was not immediately clear how the confusion over the casualties had arisen.
The Hazara minority in Kabul is concentrated in two areas, the southwestern district of Karte Seh and Taimani in the north.
